source_style_text: Façade with 4 very elongated levels under a pediment in the antique style, reflecting a very modern style at the time of its construction. Elaborate decorative program, primarily devoted to the theme of vice and virtue. Speaking signboard, probably original, by Marc De Vos. The god Apollo with his bow on the pediment, and phoenix at the top, the symbol of rebirth by fire. Ironwork on the doors with intertwining letters of the first names "Antonius" and "Sebastianus", the patron saints of archers.

source_style_text: Restrained and monumental façade, in the classical French style, topped by a domed roof finished with a belvedere. The restorers of the 19th century respected this extended program.
